Leonora Neuffer Bilger received the Francis P. Garvan–John M. Olin Medal in 1953. Her [Wikipedia biography](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leonora_Bilger) states this directly, and a [Prabook entry](https://prabook.com/web/leonora.bilger/2156495) and recipient lists agree with that year.
